grammar.label: fronting a complement or object for cohesion
grammar.meaning: puts the link to the previous sentence first, where the reader expects it

explanation.en: English normally puts the subject first, but a writer may move a complement or object to the front to link back: 'These arguments we shall examine in chapter four.' Unlike a fronted negative adverbial, this takes NO inversion — the subject and verb keep their order. The fronted element is old information; the new information then lands at the end, where the stress falls.
explanation.uz: Ingliz tilida odatda ega birinchi keladi, lekin yozuvchi oldingi gap bilan bog'lash uchun to'ldiruvchini oldinga chiqarishi mumkin: 'These arguments we shall examine in chapter four.' Inkor ravishidan farqli o'laroq, bu yerda INVERSIYA BO'LMAYDI — ega va kesim o'z o'rnida qoladi.

grammar.positive_example: Two objections remain. The first of these I have already answered.
grammar.negative_example: The first of these have I already answered.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida so'z tartibi erkinroq, shuning uchun oldinga chiqarish tabiiy tuyuladi; xato inversiyani ham qo'shib yuborishda.

grammar.label: the full cleft system — it-, wh-, reversed wh- and all-clefts
grammar.form: It is X that…; What… is X; X is what…; All… is X
grammar.meaning: splits one sentence in two so that one element carries the whole focus

explanation.en: B2 taught the it-cleft. C1 needs the set, because each puts the focus in a different place. 'It was the cost that stopped us' focuses the cost. 'What stopped us was the cost' delays it to the end. 'The cost is what stopped us' starts from the known thing. 'All that stopped us was the cost' adds 'and nothing else'. Choose by where the reader's attention already is.
explanation.uz: B2 darajada it-cleft o'rgatilgan. C1 da butun tizim kerak: har biri diqqatni boshqa joyga qo'yadi. 'It was the cost that stopped us' — sababga; 'What stopped us was the cost' — oxiriga; 'All that stopped us was the cost' — 'boshqa hech narsa emas' ma'nosini qo'shadi.

grammar.positive_example: What finally stopped the project was not the cost but the delay.
grammar.negative_example: What finally stopped the project it was the delay.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida bunday bo'linish yo'q; ta'kid zarrachalar va so'z tartibi bilan beriladi, shuning uchun cleft sun'iy tuyulishi mumkin.

body.text: The district wants to argue about the cost of the bridge.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: And what is really at issue?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Not the cost. Whether they or the ministry decide what gets built.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Then say that on page one, before a single figure.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: They will say I am avoiding the numbers.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: You will give them the numbers. But a reader who does not know what the numbers are for will use them however it suits him.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'What the two sides are really disputing is not the cost but the precedent.'

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That is a cleft, and it is doing real work. The reader now knows where to put everything that follows.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Mr Karimov used to write 'the issue is the precedent' and leave it there.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: He wrote for people who already knew. You are writing for a committee in another building.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Here is the second paragraph. 'These objections I shall take one at a time.'

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Fronted, and no inversion. Good. That is the one everybody gets wrong.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I got it wrong for a year and nobody told me.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: I am telling you now, which is cheaper than a committee telling you.
